question: What in Genesis is actually built and running, and what is still planned?
answer: Of the 12 saved Genesis project profiles, 2 have a demonstrated workflow or partly operating services (OPAL and American Science Cloud/ModCon). NNSA has 1 authorized cloud environment, with Genesis workload deployment unproved. Another 4 are being built or designed, 4 are selected or planned, and 1 is consortium membership. The separate proposed Argonne center remains market research without a solicitation or award.

items.title: OPAL plant science workflow
items.text: A reported production workflow couples ORNL plant imaging, Genesis services and Frontier.
kv: A 40-day campaign of 360 pennycress plants; ordinary data queries 3–10 seconds, provenance overhead under 1%.
Complete shared provenance/lakehouse integration and test further laboratories.
What the record does not prove
Author-reported preprint. Cold inference with queue contention takes 30 minutes–2 hours; not all science is instantaneous.

items.title: American Science Cloud and ModCon
items.text: Shared model, data and agent services over DOE facilities.
kv: Cards, model gateway, catalog and workflow primitives; OPAL demonstrates a composition.
Broader federated-training orchestration and shared data/provenance integration.
What the record does not prove
Authenticated access and provenance do not establish cryptographic signing, blockchain or PQC.

items.title: NNSA Secret/Restricted Data cloud
items.text: An authorized AWS environment intended to host inaugural Genesis workloads.
kv: NNSA reports established enterprise-authorized environment and shared tools.
Obtain dated evidence of Genesis-specific workload deployment.
What the record does not prove
Corrects the older saved claim that this release established operating Genesis workloads.

items.title: Genesis-Science-1

Post-training contributions due September14; verify model release and evaluations.
What the record does not prove

items.title: Solstice and Equinox
items.text: NVIDIA and Oracle systems planned for Argonne.
kv: Named technology partnership; existing ALCF capabilities.
Delivery and acceptance of each system; verify final configuration.
What the record does not prove
Solstice 100,000 and Equinox 10,000 GPUs are announced configurations, not installed counts.
